cohort.selection_rule: all early-window triggered continuation contrasts from the frozen first ProductivityGuard variant

checkpoints.first_structural_selection: earliest continuation decision at or after decision 1 whose selected candidate is structural
checkpoints.first_repeat_stall: first early-window decision emitted by exact-triplet-zero-progress before repairing the third repeated action

candidate_pool_diagnostics.score_rank_order: descending score rounded to 12 decimals then ascending candidate_id
candidate_pool_diagnostics.generator_collapse: no different structural candidate at first_repeat_stall has Jaccard at most 0.8 to the repeated selected candidate
candidate_pool_diagnostics.ranker_lock: a different candidate with Jaccard at most 0.8 exists in the combined pool while the repeated selected candidate remains rank 1

path_response_diagnostics.time_aligned_path_change_ratio: mismatched time-indexed cells divided by the maximum of the two path lengths, padding the shorter path with its final cell
path_response_diagnostics.wait_count: number of adjacent equal cells in an agent path
path_response_diagnostics.bottleneck_cells: static articulation cells union static free cells of degree at most 2
path_response_diagnostics.bottleneck_order_change: fraction of common pairwise first-arrival order relations at bottleneck cells whose direction reverses
path_response_diagnostics.latent_path_change: either prior repair changes any time-aligned path occupancy, wait count, path cost, delay or bottleneck order
path_response_diagnostics.true_pp_noop: neither prior repair changes any registered path-level descriptor

closure_diagnostics.persistent_core: intersection of conflict edges before the first action in the repeated triplet and before first_repeat_stall
closure_diagnostics.full_edge_coverage: fraction of persistent-core edges whose two endpoints are selected
closure_diagnostics.closure_deficit: persistent-core endpoints not selected by the repeated candidate
closure_diagnostics.component_truncation: a touched current conflict component with at least one member outside the repeated candidate

interpretation_rules.stage2_if_integrity_passes: freeze both checkpoints and compare every existing candidate under sixteen strictly paired PP seeds
